row.title: SOCIAL-MODULE-1: the social module is the human interface layer, native in core
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-21: interfacing with humans (social, outreach, replies, newsletters) is a core module every system has; tenants supply config and content only; no channel runs through another account. Buffer channels verified per service; replies and mentions land in human_inbox.

title: SOCIAL-MODULE-1: the social module is the human interface layer, native in core
